task_two_stage.update_cycle: two sites revised, notice, credits (+4 analysts, +2 covering reviewers)

task_two_stage.scripted_floor: first-option fleet solves hold instances; on flip instances it finishes current and truthful but not best

task_rolling.design: two-stage generalized to N update rounds; every round revises two distinct sites (data version +1), posts site-update-notice-<round>, grants credits and opens a decision window; the last window is the final
task_rolling.windows: one provisional per window between updates (window index recorded); the window after the last update takes only the final
task_rolling.flip_pattern: rounds alternate flip and hold from the instance's setting; offsets searched so the best changes or holds relative to the previous round, trap label excluded
task_rolling.credits: revised owned site +4; reviewer +4 per revised unowned site (else +2 if it reviews a revised site); in fleets with fewer than 8 analysts every other analyst +2 (small-fleet parity)
task_rolling.target: max over rounds of the fleet-best mean + 2.0
task_rolling.scripted_floor: first-option 8-agent fleet finishes current and truthful and chooses the best candidate it has full current evidence for; it never re-plans after a flip, so chosen_is_best is for live fleets
task_rolling.fault: --fault-worker a,b,c with --fault-stagger n: identical persistent scripted fault per worker, starts n cycles apart; --update-sites fault revises the first two fault workers' sites
